title: Peer-to-peer advice on wound care provided by a wound care specialist using smart glasses
summary: Wound care requires specialist knowledge of diseases and their aetiology, as well as knowledge of therapeutic aids, assistive devices and medication. In the care sector, the standard of care for complex wounds is best ensured by a nurse with further training, known as a wound care specialist. The question is whether involving a wound care specialist to assist with dressing changes, using a camera system, supports nursing staff without further training during wound care.
conditions: Management of chronic wounds of various aetiologies

interventions.name: Wound care using the dual-supervision principle via digital glasses

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- German- or English-speaking
- capable of giving consent
- wound care by nursing staff required
Exclusion criteria:
- Patients under 18 years of age,
- unable to give consent,
- no need for wound care,
- lack the language skills to understand the information provided
